notes.title: A Good Day Fishing is featured in the first ever Cozy Job Simulators Festival!
notes.content: [p]Hi cozy fishing fans![/p][p][/p][p]I'm excited to announce that A Good Day Fishing is featured in the first ever Cozy Job Simulators Festival! And I have some exciting news to go along with it...[/p][p][/p][p]Early alpha testing has officially begun! Thank you so much to everyone who has tested so far, your feedback has been super helpful ❤️[/p][p][/p][p]➡️ [url="https://discord.gg/WGKksJMs5a" style="button"]Join the Discord to become one of the first alpha testers![/url]⬅️[/p][p][/p][p]Happy browsing[/p][p]-Fascinaut[/p][p][/p][p]P.S. - Keep an eye out for a Steam playtest coming soon 🤫[/p]

notes.title: Check out A Good Day Fishing in the Back to School Festival!

notes.title: teaser trailer
notes.content: [p]A Good Day Fishing is taking part in the Steam Fishing Fest![/p][p][/p][h2]What the heck is A Good Day Fishing?[/h2][p]A Good Day Fishing is a gamified focus tool where you catch fish while completing real-life tasks. Reel in and record new species, decorate your favorite cozy fishing spot, and customize your soundscape to create a custom vibe to help you relax and boost concentration.[/p][p][/p][h2]Follow on Discord for more fishin' news and insider updates[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45585100/a729e54e83f65c1e25c7b8579b4c1282e2ba6e8f.png"][/img][/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/WGKksJMs5a"]Follow on Discord for more updates![/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p]
